title: WP-24 schedule triggers and WP-25 MCP tool warnings: settings UI (UI-3)

screenshots.where: the directory UI3_SHOTS names when the spec runs; the fixture-backed run of 2026-10-30 is kept out of git

routed: Two answers are served by the page's route because the states cannot be made on demand: a schedule's firings (UI3-SCH-7) and the MCP manifest with scanner findings (UI3-MCP-*; the approval request is asserted as it leaves the browser). Everything else is the stack's.

cases.title: Schedule form defaults
expected: "If PipesHub was down" has Skip the runs it missed / Run once for the latest missed time / Run once for each missed time; Skip is chosen
"If the last run is still going" has Skip this run / Wait for it to finish, then run / Run both at the same time; Skip is chosen
"Tell me when a run ends": In PipesHub ticked, Email unticked and enabled, Slack greyed with "The assistant has no Slack bot..."

cases.title: Each catch-up option
steps: Pick each "If PipesHub was down" option in turn
expected: The picked option is checked
Run once for each missed time explains "Up to 24, oldest first, one after another."

cases.title: Each overlap option
steps: Pick each "If the last run is still going" option in turn
expected: The picked option is checked
Wait for it to finish explains "One run can wait. If another is due while one waits, it is skipped."

cases.title: Slack greyed for an agent without a bot; the chosen policies are stored
steps: Pick a seeded agent (the stack has no Slack bot)
Pick run all, wait, tick Email
expected: GET /api/v1/agent-harness/schedules/notify-channels?agentKey=... answers (an agent the caller may not run is 404); Slack is greyed with "This agent has no Slack bot. Add one in Slack settings to get messages there."
POST body has trigger.catchUp run_all, overlap queue, notify [in_app, email]; Node answers 201 with the same overlap and notify

cases.title: Signed webhook dialog
steps: Choose When a webhook is called ("The caller can't sign" stays unticked)
expected: POST trigger is {kind: webhook, auth: signature}; the answer carries webhookSecret, no webhookToken
The dialog shows the address, the secret, "Copy this secret now. You won't see it again.", how to sign, and a signing example with X-PipesHub-Timestamp and X-PipesHub-Signature: v1=$sig
The secret is not in the page after Done

cases.title: Token fallback for a caller that can't sign
steps: Choose When a webhook is called
Tick "The caller can't sign. Use a token in a header instead"
expected: The choice warns "Anyone who sees the token can call it. Signing is safer."
POST trigger is {kind: webhook, auth: token}; the dialog names the X-PipesHub-Trigger-Token header and shows no signing example

cases.title: History rows: skipped (last run still going), waiting, caught up
steps: Create a cron schedule (run all, queue) through the API
Serve its firings by route: overlap_queued, overlap_skip, overlap_queue_full, and an admitted slot made a day late
expected: The row's summary says Run once for each missed time
Rows read: Waiting for the last run to finish; Skipped: the last run was still going; Skipped: a run was already waiting; Scheduled (caught up)
No row says Missed while PipesHub was down

cases.title: MCP tab: a clean tool
steps: Open the MCP server's Tool approval tab
expected: The approved tool without findings has no warnings box

cases.title: MCP tab: a flagged tool
expected: "This tool's text reads like instructions to the AI (3)", expanded, each finding as a plain label and its passage; no finding code shown
The box collapses and expands
"I've read these warnings and still want agents to get this tool." under the findings

cases.title: Acknowledge, then approve
expected: Approve is disabled with "Confirm the warnings on \"add\" to approve it." until the box is ticked
A 409 mcp_tool_description_flagged reads "Nothing was approved: a tool's warnings weren't confirmed..."
PUT .../manifest sends {name: add, digest, acknowledgeWarnings: true} and the clean tool without it

cases.title: A changed flagged tool is confirmed again
expected: The changed tool shows its description diff and its new findings, unconfirmed; Approve is off until confirmed
PUT sends {name: fetch, digest: the new one, acknowledgeWarnings: true}
